pages.title: Tenderleaf Dovetail Dollhouse
pages.description: The Tenderleaf Dovetail Dollhouse, is a large spacious and ultra-stylish, traditional 1:12 scale wooden doll house with six rooms on three levels
pages.ld_description:
The Tenderleaf Dovetail Dollhouse is a stylish and spacious 1:12 scale wooden dollhouse featuring six rooms across three levels, ready for you to furnish. It opens in the middle to showcase all three floors, complete with a chic open staircase for easy access.
Adorned with window boxes full of plants, window shutters, a cozy porch, and a seasonal wreath on the front door, this dollhouse radiates warmth and charm. A visiting dove and a friendly fox add to the welcoming atmosphere.
Constructed from high-quality birch plywood and sustainable rubberwood furniture, the Tenderleaf Dovetail Dollhouse is built to last. Its beautifully printed plywood floors and gender-neutral colors make it an exceptional choice for imaginative play.
 

 	Traditional 1:12 scale Wooden Doll House
 	Six Rooms on Three Floors
 	Made from sustainable rubber wood ( a new tree planted for each one used in the making of Tender Leaf Toys )
 	Finished with non-toxic paint
 	ICTI seal of approval for high ethical standards in their factory
 	Self-assembly required
 	Presented in an illustrated colour box.
 	Dolls and furniture sold separately.
 	For ages: 3 years +

 
Dimensions: 68 x 39.5 x 69.5 cm
